The leads you need are already in your CRM.

Somewhere in your phone or your CRM sits a stack of people who already raised their hand once. They called for a quote, filled out a form, or booked and never came back. Then everyone went quiet.

A brand new lead costs ad spend and a cold introduction. A dormant contact already knows your name and what you do.

This week, pull every contact your business hasn't touched in 90 days. Send one text: "Still need this handled? We've got space this week." No pitch, no discount, just the door open again.

The platform runs this exact win-back sequence on autopilot, so it never depends on you remembering. See it work on your own list, free for 14 days, no card required.
